title: Theoretical Foundations of Wasserstein Policy Optimization

contributions.purpose: 给出 WPO 的投影式理论视角
contributions.mechanism: 2-Wasserstein 梯度流 + Fisher/KL 内积投影,得含混合导交叉项的协变自然步
contributions.evaluation: 形式化推导(Thm 2:投影到自然梯度;定性,无数值实验)
contributions.domain: 强化学习理论 / 最优传输
contributions.source_quote: We make this projection-based view explicit... yields a covariant natural step with a mixed-derivative cross-term.

contributions.mechanism: 约束 Gâteaux 变分证基线不变性;Fisher pullback 证参数化协变性
contributions.source_quote: prove baseline invariance (via a constrained Gáteaux variation) and parameterization covariance (via Fisher pullbacks)

contributions.purpose: 给出高斯策略可实现更新
contributions.mechanism: 推导均值/协方差更新,含保持 SPD 的全协方差 Cholesky 实现
contributions.evaluation: Gaussian 更新公式 + full-covariance Cholesky(保 SPD;定性)
contributions.source_quote: For Gaussian policies we give mean and covariance updates, including a full-covariance Cholesky implementation that preserves SPD.

contributions.purpose: 扩展到 c-Wasserstein 并给稳定性
contributions.mechanism: 用凸共轭得 c-Wasserstein 动力学,冻结 critic 下推能量不等式
contributions.source_quote: We extend to c-Wasserstein dynamics to obtain principled stability via convex conjugates and state precise energy inequalities in the frozen-critic regime.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We revisit Wasserstein Policy Optimization (WPO) as policy transport on action densities followed by a projection onto a parametric manifold.
We extend to c-Wasserstein dynamics to obtain principled stability via convex conjugates

notes: 非实证纯理论:全文仅定理/命题/引理及证明,自认 'No datasets or empirical experiments are involved',四元组 evaluation 为证明结论(允许非数字)。适配问题:evaluation 无量化指标,填理论命题。AI agent 署名一作;decision=desk-reject。温和红旗:AI 生成证明未经同行验证,'label-anchored derivations' 为自造表述,主要证明置于附录 A/B。
